blocks.text: Software development tools are essential for creating, testing and maintaining software applications. They help developers write code, find and fix errors and manage software projects effectively.

blocks.prompt: Discuss the importance of software development tools (long question 6).
blocks.explanation: Editors make writing code faster with features such as highlighting; translators (interpreters and compilers) turn the code into something the computer can run; debuggers show exactly where errors occur; IDEs bring all of these together; repositories keep a history of changes so a team can work on one project safely. Examples: VS Code, the Python interpreter, GCC, GDB, PyCharm, GitHub. Together they make development quicker and more accurate.

items: Development tools help write, test, debug and manage code; covered next: editors, translators, compilers, debuggers, IDEs, platforms, repositories.
